padding-top: 7px!important;
}

margin-bottom: 15px;
}

{
margin-left:1%;
margin-right:1%;
}

{

}

/*FAQ*/
div[data-style*="minimal"] .toggle.open {
background-color: #EFE1D4!important;
border-radius: 20px!important;
margin-top: 10px!important;
margin-bottom: 10px!important;
}

body .toggles--minimal-shadow .toggle {
padding: 0 20px!important;
}


body .dark div[data-style*="minimal"].toggles--minimal-shadow .toggle:not(.open):not(:hover) > .toggle-title i {
border-color: #FBF2E9!important;
}

div[data-style="minimal"] .toggle.accent-color.open i{
border-color: #EFE1D4!important;
}
div[data-style*=minimal] .toggle>.toggle-title i {
border:none!important;
}


.toggles--minimal-shadow .toggle:before {
box-shadow:none!important;
}


/*КНОПКИ - PRICE*//*
@media only screen and (max-width: 999px) {
.button-price {
display:none!important;
}}

@media only screen and (min-width: 1000px) {
.button-price-mob {
display:none!important;
} }


/*----------------------Блог----------------------------------------------*/


/*Расстояния в карточках от фото*/
.nectar-post-grid-wrap:not([data-style=content_overlaid]) .nectar-post-grid .nectar-post-grid-item .content {
padding: 10px 0!important;
}

/*Цвет заголовков*/
.full-width-section>.col.span_12.dark .nectar-post-grid[data-text-color=dark] .nectar-post-grid-item .content *,
.nectar-post-grid[data-text-color=dark] .nectar-post-grid-item .content *
{
color: #372426!important;
}


/*Отступ Dropdown*/

.dropdown-right {
padding-right:10px!important;
}

.sf-menu, .sf-menu *{
line-height: 23px!important;
}


/*МОБИЛЬНОЕ МЕНЮ*/

/*БУРГЕР*/


@media only screen and (min-width: 1px) and (max-width: 999px) {
body #header-outer .slide-out-widget-area-toggle.mobile-icon .lines:before {
top: 7px!important;
}
}

body #header-outer .slide-out-widget-area-toggle[data-custom-color=true] .lines:after {
top: -7px!important;
}

/*МЕНЮ*/
body #slide-out-widget-area .inner-wrap > .inner .off-canvas-menu-container li > a {
letter-spacing: -0.02em!important;
}


@media only screen and (max-width: 690px) {
#slide-out-widget-area.fullscreen-split .off-canvas-menu-container>ul>li {
margin-bottom: 24px!important;
padding-bottom: 20px!important;
border-bottom: 1px solid #EFE1D4!important;
}
}

@media only screen and (max-width: 690px) {
#slide-out-widget-area.fullscreen-split .inner-wrap>.inner>.container {
margin-left: 3%!important;
}}



#slide-out-widget-area .bottom-text {
font-size: 16px!important;
line-height:30px!important;
}

/*БЛОГ*/

.nectar-post-grid-filters a {
/*border: 1px solid #372426!important;
border-radius: 10px!important;
padding-left:10px!important;
padding-right:10px!important;*/
text-transform: uppercase!important;
letter-spacing: -0.05em!important;
}

.nectar-post-grid-filters a {
margin: 10px 12px!important;
font-size: 16px !important;
}

/*Отступы тегов*/
.nectar-post-grid-wrap .category-position-overlaid .nectar-post-grid-item .meta-category {
top: 10px!important;
left: 10px!important;
}

.nectar-post-grid .nectar-post-grid-item .content
{
width: 90%!important;
}

.featured-media-under-header__cat-wrap .meta-category a {
margin-right: 4px!important;
}

<script type="text/javascript">
(function(window, document) {

document.documentElement.classList.remove("no-js");

if(navigator.userAgent.match(/(Android|iPod|iPhone|iPad|BlackBerry|IEMobile|Opera Mini)/)) {
document.body.className += " using-mobile-browser mobile ";
}
if(navigator.userAgent.match(/Mac/) && navigator.maxTouchPoints && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 2) {
document.body.className += " using-ios-device ";
}

if( !("ontouchstart" in window) ) {

var body = document.querySelector("body");
var winW = window.innerWidth;
var bodyW = body.clientWidth;

if (winW > bodyW + 4) {
body.setAttribute("style", "--scroll-bar-w: " + (winW - bodyW - 4) + "px");
} else {
body.setAttribute("style", "--scroll-bar-w: 0px");
}
}

})(window, document);
</script><a href="#ajax-content-wrap" class="nectar-skip-to-content">Skip to main content</a><div class="ocm-effect-wrap"><div class="ocm-effect-wrap-inner"><div id="ajax-loading-screen" data-disable-mobile="1" data-disable-fade-on-click="0" data-effect="standard" data-method="standard"><div class="loading-icon none"><div class="material-icon">

<div class="toggles accordion toggles--minimal-shadow" data-br="20px" data-starting="default" data-style="minimal"><div class="toggle accent-color" data-inner-wrap="true"><h3 class="toggle-title"><a href="#" role="button" class="nectar-inherit-h4 toggle-heading"><i role="presentation" class="fa fa-plus"></i>How does Lipedema Guru help me understand lipedema?</a></h3><div><div class="inner-toggle-wrap">
<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
<p>We offer research-based insights to clarify your body’s signals, like hormonal triggers, helping you navigate lipedema symptoms with knowledge and resilience.</p>
</div>



</div></div></div><div class="toggle accent-color" data-inner-wrap="true"><h3 class="toggle-title"><a href="#" role="button" class="nectar-inherit-h4 toggle-heading"><i role="presentation" class="fa fa-plus"></i>Are consultations in-person or virtual?</a></h3><div><div class="inner-toggle-wrap">
<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
<p>All consultations are virtual via Zoom or Google Meets, ensuring accessibility and convenience with emailed details.</p>
</div>



</div></div></div><div class="toggle accent-color" data-inner-wrap="true"><h3 class="toggle-title"><a href="#" role="button" class="nectar-inherit-h4 toggle-heading"><i role="presentation" class="fa fa-plus"></i>What options are available for General Consultations?</a></h3><div><div class="inner-toggle-wrap">
<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
<p>Choose a 1-hour session with a personalized lipedema report or one with Bioresonance Hair Testing (IgG-based), including an additional sensitivity report and 30-minute follow-up.</p>
</div>



</div></div></div><div class="toggle accent-color" data-inner-wrap="true"><h3 class="toggle-title"><a href="#" role="button" class="nectar-inherit-h4 toggle-heading"><i role="presentation" class="fa fa-plus"></i>How do I know if the Pre- and Post-Surgery Consultation is right for me?</a></h3><div><div class="inner-toggle-wrap">
<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
<p>If you’re preparing for or recovering from lipedema surgery, this consultation provides education to manage symptoms, tailored to your surgical phase.</p>
</div>



</div></div></div><div class="toggle accent-color" data-inner-wrap="true"><h3 class="toggle-title"><a href="#" role="button" class="nectar-inherit-h4 toggle-heading"><i role="presentation" class="fa fa-plus"></i>What is the Lipedema Guru report?</a></h3><div><div class="inner-toggle-wrap">
<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
<p>A report based on the pre-consultation quiz and consultation offers tailored insights on managing lipedema symptoms, created with consented PII/PHI data.</p>
</div>



</div></div></div><div class="toggle accent-color" data-inner-wrap="true"><h3 class="toggle-title"><a href="#" role="button" class="nectar-inherit-h4 toggle-heading"><i role="presentation" class="fa fa-plus"></i>Do I need to consent for the consultation?</a></h3><div><div class="inner-toggle-wrap">
<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
<p>Consent for PII/PHI use is required for the personalized report but optional for a basic consultation without reports.</p>
</div>



</div></div></div><div class="toggle accent-color" data-inner-wrap="true"><h3 class="toggle-title"><a href="#" role="button" class="nectar-inherit-h4 toggle-heading"><i role="presentation" class="fa fa-plus"></i>Can General Consultations diagnose lipedema?</a></h3><div><div class="inner-toggle-wrap">
<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
<p>No, consultations and IgG Tests provide CAM-based education, not diagnoses. Consult a healthcare provider for medical diagnosis.</p>
</div>



</div></div></div><div class="toggle accent-color" data-inner-wrap="true"><h3 class="toggle-title"><a href="#" role="button" class="nectar-inherit-h4 toggle-heading"><i role="presentation" class="fa fa-plus"></i>How does the consultation support daily life?</a></h3><div><div class="inner-toggle-wrap">
<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
<p>Education on nutrition, movement, and mindset helps you manage lipedema symptoms, fostering resilience to thrive in daily activities.</p>
</div>



</div></div></div></div>
